reading: Six everyday actions in order: measure first, fix the foundations, choose parts you can swap, hand over keys one at a time, train the crew, finish the rooms with people at home; a line under steps 2 to 6 marks the inspection at every step.
headline: Renovate in this order, with the people at home, and inspect as you go.
